name: envcheck
one_liner: Drift and secret checks for dotenv files: template<->env drift, syntax and encoding diagnostics, and known-prefix credential detection.
problem: Leaked .env files are the #1 documented cause of large-scale credential-harvest incidents (Palo Alto Networks Unit 42 2024), while .env.example / .env drift keeps producing production outages caught only at request time. Existing tools are either heavy Rust binaries, hosted services, or Node/Ruby-specific. A small, zero-dep, Python-native linter that runs in CI and as a pre-commit hook is the missing primitive.
